aquarium.note: CSS-3D fish tank, inspired by CSS 3D Lab (MIT); drag to rotate, feed, add fish.

arcade.note: Game loop, unified input, collision, simple physics, particles, scores, accessible UI, quiz.

balloon.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). A hot-air balloon that rises, drifts and is steered; CSS 3D Lab has a hot-air model for reference (MIT, credit).

bloom.note: Seeded procedural flowers with bezier petals that unfold on touch.

bracket.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). A tournament bracket with match-ups the user picks through to a winner.

capture.note: window.adventCapture hook (register), markPrivate, ready(), canvas → PNG/WebM, share-mark corner check.

cassette.note: Cassette player: spinning reels, drag to scrub, side A/B tracklist.

charts.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). Deadpan bar/line/pie charts as inline SVG for the annual report (pairs with document/layouts.js).

confetti.note: burst() uses vendored canvas-confetti (ISC) when inlined, else a tiny built-in burst.

countdown.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). A countdown to a date with a reveal at zero; use the local clock only.

crossword.note: Crossword/word-search engine with seeded placement, numbering and checks.

crystal.note: CSS-3D faceted crystal, inspired by CSS 3D Lab (MIT); drag to spin, inclusions.

css-3d-box.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). A CSS-3D box/matchbox that slides or lifts open; the paper/ blocks and toys/crystal.js show the preserve-3d patterns.

document.note: Deadpan layouts: certificate, newspaper, annual report, patent, award, museum label; print CSS.

envelope.note: CSS-3D envelope: flap opens, letter slides out.

escape-locks.note: Code, riddle and sequence locks with normalisation and room progress.

film-scenes.note: Scenes drawn to a canvas and recorded to WebM; titles, cards and timing live in the template.

gallery.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). A museum gallery wall/room with framed exhibits and labels (pairs with document/layouts.js museum label).

generative.note: Seeded randomness and noise, palettes, SVG helpers.

jelly.note: Volume-preserving mass-spring soft body with translucent rendering; pure stepJelly() for tests.

karaoke.note: Lyrics highlighted in time with a score.json, inline synth, mute, no autoplay.

maker.note: Mini-app shell, local storage fallback, clipboard/downloads, cheat sheets.

physics-2d.note: Vendored matter-js 0.20.0 (MIT) for rigid-body piles, ropes and stacks.

pop.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). Poppable bubbles (bubble wrap): hit-testing, pop animation and a short synthesized pop sound after a gesture.

pop-up-card.note: CSS-3D card that opens on click/drag with layered pop-up elements and paper texture.

scratch.note: Scratch-off canvas layer reporting % revealed, with a Reveal button.

shake.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). A standalone shake detector (pointer velocity + devicemotion after permission + keyboard); toys/snow-globe.js contains one to copy.

snow-globe.note: Canvas 2D globe: glass highlight, snow with inertia, shake by drag/motion/Space, object slots.

stars.note: Planned: not in the kit yet; the agent builds it from scratch in the gift (allowed by gift-library/README.md). A starfield with connectable constellations drawn by tapping stars.
